notes.title: Dev Update: Dynamic Localization & Dual-Item Interaction Improvements
notes.notes:
Hey folks!
We’ve got a fresh batch of updates and fixes to share:

🌐 [b]Dynamic localization is here![/b]
Menu elements now update in real time when you switch languages — no restart needed.

🛠️ [b]Dual-item interactions improved:[/b]
 We’ve fixed several issues when holding two items at once, including:
[list]
[*] Sifting flour with a sieve
[*] Grating cheese with the grater
[/list]

Thanks for following along — more features are cooking!🍕

notes.title: Dev Update: Simulation Tweaks & Visual Polish
notes.notes:
Hey folks!
 We’re back with another roundup of recent improvements and fixes:
[list]
[*] Ingredient placement has been optimized, and the game runs more smoothly when handling small items.
[*] Water evaporation is now more realistic, with separate heating and drying phases.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533992/4d9e89d3a3ef2f80ebc9c40c83fbded33a15885b.gif[/img]
[*] Small ingredients look better when placed inside containers.
[*] Hair now looks smoother and more natural.
[*] Kitchen tools work more reliably — actions like pouring flour or using the grater are now more consistent.
[*] Minor bug fixes and overall stability improvements.
[/list]
Thanks for staying with us — more updates are on the way! 🔧✨
